regime_context: Canada/TSX thematic rotation is broad (69% of themes eligible) with no single dominant narrative. Big Banks leads, showing high durability and broad participation but crowded. The absolute trend gate—the detector’s only validated risk-control edge—is positive (gate_helps true). Gold Miners and Silver & Royalties are ineligible, signalling trend weakness. Base Metals & Copper is eligible but has weak durability and very narrow breadth, undermining its trend reliability.
emerging_watch: Pipelines & Midstream: although currently unscorable, if a scorable ETF proxy emerges and durability remains high (above 0.70), watch for a potential leadership handoff from Big Banks. Kill criterion: durability drops below 0.60 or theme fails absolute trend gate.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the ranked leader, remains eligible under the absolute trend gate (validated for drawdown avoidance), and shows high durability (0.72) with maximum breadth (1.0). Crowding (Z 1.2) is a size-down caution, not a fade trigger, per guardrails. The overweight bias is a fallible judgement that high durability and trend-eligibility support modest outperformance relative to benchmark, not a return forecast from the rank.
theses.dissent: Crowded positions can suffer sharp unwind and the mixed Hurst tag suggests trend is not robust; mean-reversion risk is elevated.

falsifier.text: Big Banks loses eligibility (absolute trend gate flips false) OR ZEB.TO closes below its 50-day simple moving average.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Although eligible, Base Metals & Copper exhibits very low durability (0.47) and extremely narrow breadth (0.111). Such an internal structure implies fragile leadership and a high risk of whipsaw, consistent with the absolute trend discipline to avoid weak trends. The underweight expects this theme to deliver poor risk-adjusted performance over the short term.
evidence: durability_bar: 0.47 (lowest among the top 4 eligible themes)
theses.dissent: Copper supply disruptions or a China stimulus could ignite a rapid rally, and narrow breadth may actually reflect a concentrated, high-alpha move that the detector cannot distinguish.

falsifier.text: Durability_bar rises above 0.60 and breadth rises above 0.50 and holds for 5 trading days.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is ineligible under the absolute trend gate, the detector’s only validated edge for drawdown control. Avoiding ineligible themes is a direct application of the trend discipline to reduce shake-out risk, irrespective of its negative momentum score. The conviction is medium because the gate has a proven track record of reducing drawdowns and this market’s backtest shows gate_helps is true.
evidence: hurst_tag: trend, but trend does not guarantee gate passage
theses.dissent: A geopolitical or macro shock could ignite gold miners irrespective of trend health; the avoid stance may cause underperformance if such a shock occurs.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners becomes eligible (eligibility flips to true) and stays eligible for 5 consecutive trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
